newsitem.title: GREECE: STOCKS TO TOP 1,640PTS IF TURNOVER RISES- OMEGA.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS TO TOP 1,640PTS IF TURNOVER RISES- OMEGA.

text.p: A medium-term resistance level at 1,640 points will only be breached if turnover grows further, Omega Securities said in a technical analysis report.

"Whereas short-term indicators suggest there is room for a rise of the general index to its medium-term resistance at 1,640 points, medium-term indicators suggest it is unlikely to see it climb further at current volume levels," it said.
Current trading volume levels will sustain the medium term consolidation of prices with the general index fluctuating between 1,530 and 1,615 points, it added.
The market's sharp rise which was coupled with a slight pick up in turnover last Thursday and Friday ruled out a downturn below a medium-term support level of 1,530 points.

"The index has already penetrated upwards its 30-day moving average amidst rising turnover in the last two sessions," Omega said. "There appears little chance of a drop below 1,530 points which is a strong medium-term support level." --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
